description: HP-39 is the Registering and Licensing Authority (RLA) code for the Dharamshala sub-division in Himachal Pradesh. Operating under the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), it manages the registration of non-transport vehicles and issuance of driving licenses for the local region. It functions alongside other regional codes like HP-04 and HP-68 to serve the administrative needs of the Kangra district.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Dharamshala, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh
